documents.excerpt: Beyond the battlefields, Alexander the Great executed one of history’s most sweeping economic blueprints. By unlocking the Persian Empire's hoarded treasures, founding over twenty cities, and introducing a single monetary standard—the silver tetradrachm—he engineered a vast, hyper-connected Hellenistic marketplace. A strategic deconstruction of the ancient world's most enduring economic empire.
documents.seoDescription: How Alexander the Great's economic blueprint, from standardising silver to founding Alexandria, shaped global trade networks for centuries.
documents.title: The Alexandrian Blueprint intel dossier
